verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents its own non-GUI execution paths. The official CLI can "create, train, run, and manage crews & flows", `crewai test` runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports performance metrics, and deployed crews can be triggered via REST (POST /kickoff, GET /status). Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines specifically, so the CI part of the story is only implied. missing for 10: CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive/headless flags and exit-code behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows.
This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics.
Access your deployed crews via REST API for integration with existing systems
